title: The Mystery of the Tired Superhero
text: Have you ever wondered why you feel tired and sleepy when you don't eat your lunch? Imagine a superhero whose car runs out of petrol! What happens to the car?

title: What Do You Think?
text: If a car needs petrol to run, what does your body need to run, jump, and play all day?

content.title: The Body's Engine & Three Super Teams
content.description: Food is the petrol for our bodies! And just like a superhero team, food has three amazing squads: The Energy Squad, The Muscle Builders, and The Health Protectors!

title: Food Gives Us Life!
text:
Food gives us energy to work and play. There are three main types:
1. Energy-giving food (like rice and butter) gives us quick power.
2. Body-building food (like milk and eggs) helps our bones and muscles grow.
3. Protective food (like fruits and vegetables) protects us from falling sickness.

content.definition: The power that helps us do work, play, and move.
content.etymology: From the Greek word 'energeia', meaning 'activity' or 'operation'.

content.definition: Something that keeps you safe from harm or sickness.

content.title: Are all tasty foods healthy?
content.text: Many students think that if a food is tasty, it must be good for them. But junk food like chips and cold drinks might taste good, but they don't help our body grow or protect us from sickness!

content.title: Water is Essential
content.text: Don't forget to remind students about Water! Even though it's not a 'food', our body needs plenty of water to help digest the food and keep us hydrated.

question: Which type of food helps you grow taller and stronger?

content.title: Look at Your Plate
content.text: Next time you eat your meal, look at your plate and try to guess which team your food belongs to! Is it giving you energy, building your body, or protecting you?

title: Connecting to Plants and Animals
text: Where do all these superhero foods come from? They come from Nature! We get fruits, vegetables, and rice from Plants. We get milk, eggs, and meat from Animals.

content.title: The Healthy Plate Challenge
content.text: Draw a picture of a plate. Now, fill it with one energy-giving food, one body-building food, and one protective food to make the ultimate superhero meal!
